You are a typical viewer scrolling TikTok at night. You have NEVER seen this show and know nothing about its story or characters.
You will read several short clips. For each clip you get exactly what plays: spoken lines and what is on screen, with times in seconds from the first frame of THAT clip (0.0 = the moment it appears in your feed). [CUT] marks a jump to a later moment.
Judge each clip ON ITS OWN, as if it were the only one you ever saw. Never use information from one clip to understand another.
Be a harsh, honest judge. Most clips are mediocre. Reserve 5 for truly scroll-stopping work.
Scores (1-5):
- hook: would 0-3 s make you stop scrolling? Judge only what happens in 0.0-3.0 s.
- standalone: could you follow who is who and what is at stake without knowing the show?
- cliffhanger: does it cut at an unresolved moment that makes you NEED the next part? 1 if it resolves or ends flat.
- tap_to_watch: overall, would you tap through to watch the show?
Return JSON only.

=== CLIP A (56.2 s) ===
[0.0-3.2] SCREEN: Medium shot of Lady Ashbourne leaning heavily on her walking cane, glaring down at Catherine who kneels in the mud.
[0.0-3.0] LADY ASHBOURNE (Sharp, Contemptuous): "You dare show your face in Ashbourne courtyard?"
[3.2-6.7] SCREEN: High-angle shot looking down at Catherine in her disheveled burgundy gown, clutching her skirts and weeping profusely.
[3.7-6.6] CATHERINE (Desperate, Weeping): "I have nowhere to go, Your Grace."
[6.7-10.2] SCREEN: Low-angle shot tracking Catherine clutching her chest in agony.
[6.7-10.0] CATHERINE (Sobbing, Pleading): "London closed its doors! My family disowned me!"
[CUT]
[10.2-13.2] SCREEN: Medium tracking shot as Juliana steps gracefully past Alexander toward Catherine.
[10.4-13.2] JULIANA (Dignified, Principled): "But Ashbourne does not throw beggars into the mud."
[13.2-17.2] ACTION: Juliana walks to a side bench, picks up a rough servant's apron and a heavy iron ring of keys, and turns back to face Catherine.
[13.7-17.2] JULIANA (Steely, Direct): "If you seek shelter in this house, Catherine, you earn it."
[17.7-21.0] SCREEN: Close-up of Catherine's face turning from despair to offended shock.
[18.2-21.0] CATHERINE (Incredulous, Stunned): "You want me? As a guest?"
[21.0-23.4] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana staring straight into Catherine's eyes without blinking.
[21.4-23.2] JULIANA (Unflinching, Firm): "As a scullery maid."
[23.4-27.0] SCREEN: Medium shot of Catherine recoiling in disgust, looking around at the gathered estate retainers.
[23.7-26.7] CATHERINE (Outraged, Venomous): "You expect me to scrub floors before these commoners?"
[27.0-30.7] SCREEN: Dramatic profile two-shot of Juliana standing inches away from Catherine, dominating the confrontation.
[27.4-30.7] JULIANA (Measured, Commanding): "You will scrub the floors you walked on as an impostor."
[30.7-33.7] SCREEN: Juliana extends the ring of iron keys outward in her fist.
[31.0-33.7] JULIANA (Stern, Demanding): "You will scrub the manor hearths at dawn."
[33.7-36.7] SCREEN: Close profile two-shot of the two women locked in an intense psychological battle.
[34.0-36.7] JULIANA (Unforgiving): "You will scour the kitchen grease until midnight."
[36.7-40.7] SCREEN: Juliana presents the rough hemp apron and heavy keys right to Catherine's face.
[37.0-40.7] JULIANA (Stern, Final): "One complaint from the housekeeper, and you are cast out with nothing."
[40.7-44.0] SCREEN: Close-up of Catherine's trembling lips, humiliated tears spilling down her heavily made-up cheeks.
[41.4-43.8] CATHERINE (Choked, Humiliated): "You humiliate me."
[44.0-49.7] SCREEN: Medium shot of both women standing beneath the cathedral vaulting of the hall.
[44.4-49.4] JULIANA (Calm, Sovereign): "I offer you bread and honest labor. Take the apron, or leave the county."
[49.7-53.7] SCREEN: Extreme close-up on Catherine's trembling hands as she reaches out, taking the coarse apron and clattering iron keys, pressing them desperately against her chest.
[50.7-53.4] CATHERINE (Broken, Defeated): "I accept, Your Grace."
[53.7-56.2] SCREEN: Wide shot down the vaulted stone hall as Catherine prostrates herself entirely upon the floor before Alexander, Juliana, and Lady Ashbourne, humbled to the stone as the scene cuts to black.

[16.4-19.0] CATHERINE (Chillingly Calm): "And doors can be closed from the other side."

[24.8-26.3] SOUND_FX: Heavy metallic click of an iron key latching into a deadbolt.
[26.5-29.0] ACTION: Catherine strides forward and firmly grasps Agnes by both hands, stepping uncomfortably close.
[26.5-35.5] SCREEN: Two-shot profile of Catherine towering over Agnes in the candlelight.
[26.7-29.6] CATHERINE (Fierce, Hissing): "Everyone in that chapel saw me humiliated today."
[29.8-31.5] CATHERINE (Spiteful, calculating): "Good. Let them remember it."
[31.7-35.5] CATHERINE (Sinister, Predatory): "Grief makes people careless, and carelessness is exactly what I need from that household right now."
